newsitem.title: UK: Eurotunnel Feb cars, Eurostar throughput up.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel Feb cars, Eurostar throughput up.

text.p: Anglo-French channel tunnel operator Eurotunnel SA /Eurotunnel Plc said on Thursday that in February, while its freight shuttle operations remained suspended after last year's fire, the volume of cars carried on its Le Shuttle and the throughput of Eurostar trains both rose.
In its monthly traffic data, the operator said Le Shuttle carried 123,915 cars and 2,445 coaches, up from 117,458 cars and 2,959 coaches in the same year-ago month.
Eurostar passenger volume rose to 391,797 passengers from 299,317 a year ago. In both cases the volumes were higher in February than in January this year.
Eurostar trains are operated by French and Belgian national railways and in Britain by EPS, a consortium which includes National Express Group Plc and the Virgin Group

While Eurotunnel's freight shuttle business remains suspended, ferry companies plying the English Channel are carrying the displaced traffic. In its comparative figures, Eurotunnel noted that it carried 46,454 trucks last February.

Meanwhile, through bulk freight trains operated by Railfreight also carried more in February, for a total of 218,238 tonnes compared with 190,078 tonnes a year ago, and up by 18 percent on January's total throughput.
